title: tephrosia arabica
intro: Tephrosia arabica, commonly known as Arak or Egyptian Thorn, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia arabica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, making it effective in reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and lowering fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
